_doc: Ash's conditions (conditions.gd). conditions.<id>: name, levels [[from strength, name, description]], desc, icon (a drawn glyph: drop, sweat, bolt, heart, sun, snow, dot, or a res:// picture), color, order (badge order), stack (max | add | replace: how a new apply combines), duration {kind: decay (full_minutes: game minutes a full strength lasts) | timer (minutes, refresh) | manual (until: the badge's line)}, left / held (the badge's time line), by_strength (effects scale with strength), effects {speed, stamina_drain, stamina_regen, no_run, blocks_entry}, remark {key, strong_key, strong_at, min, cooldown (game minutes)}: the townspeople's lines are in dialogue.json people.<id>.remarks.<key>. entry.<place>: speaker, voice, open, refuse.<condition> {above, lines, never}; 'default' covers places without their own entry. remarks_per_talk: how many conditions one talk may comment on. Levels may carry their own effects as a fourth entry ([from, name, description, {effects}]), used instead of effects while that level shows (hunger: its levels set by hunger.gd). meter: 'fullness' shows Ash's fullness (hunger.gd) in the badge's bar. More effects: stamina_max (the stamina bar's size: running drains it 1/x as fast), run_speed (running only), jump (jump height), dry_rate (how fast the wet dries).

wet.name: Wet
levels: Damp
Your shoes and socks are wet from the water. They squelch.
Wet
Wet from the water up past the knees. Drying in the air, from the top down.
Soaked
Soaked through, dripping everywhere. Some places won't let you in like this.

fatigue.name: Fatigued
levels: Fatigued
Out of breath. No running until your stamina is full again.

hungry.name: Hungry
hungry._note: hunger.gd sets the strength from Ash's fullness (tunables/hunger.json levels): Peckish 0.34, Hungry 0.67, Starving 1.0. Gentle on purpose: it never stops him running.
levels: Peckish
Your tummy's starting to rumble. A snack would be nice.
Hungry
Your stomach growls. Your stamina comes back a little slower until you eat.
Starving
So hungry! Your stamina refills slowly and runs out a bit sooner. Eat at home, the inn or the tea house.

well_fed.name: Well fed
levels: Well fed
A good meal in your belly. Your stamina comes back faster and lasts longer, and you run and jump a little better.

stuffed.name: Stuffed
levels: Stuffed
You ate a LOT. Running feels a bit heavy until it settles. Your stamina still comes back nicely.

sugar_rush.name: Sugar rush
levels: Sugar rush
Something sweet! A burst of energy: your stamina comes back faster for a little while.

scraped.name: Scraped & Dirty
scraped._note: battle/battle_defeat.gd: knocked down by a wild Pokemon. Dirt and scratches show on his clothes and skin (body.gd: the actor shader's dirt), he limps (actor.gd limp), runs slower and tires sooner. Wears off with time, faster resting (standing still, sitting down: body.gd); Nurse Joy patches it right up (BattleDefeat.joy_heals).
levels: A bit scuffed
Still a little sore and grubby. Nearly better.
Scraped & Dirty
Scratched up and covered in dirt from that Pidgey. You limp a bit, run slower and tire sooner. Rest, or see Nurse Joy.

warm.name: Warmed up
levels: Warmed up
Something hot inside you. Warm right through: you dry off twice as fast.

lines: Whoa, whoa! Ash, you're dripping wet!
The professor has research notes spread all over the floor in here.
Wait outside until you dry off, OK? The sun will sort you out.
Ash Ketchum, you are NOT walking that water through my clean house!
Stand on the porch and drip dry first, sweetie. Then come in and I'll make cocoa.
Oh, dearie, look at you! Not on my good rug.
Wait out on the step till you've dried a bit. I'll put the kettle on.
Flour and puddles make paste, Ash!
Dry off outside first, would you?
You're dripping wet! Wait outside until you dry off.
